newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss jobless rate hits record 5.7 percent.
newsitem.headline: Swiss jobless rate hits record 5.7 percent.

text.p: Swiss unemployment jumped to a record 5.7 percent in January as seasonal factors accentuated the stagnant economy's inability to generate new jobs, officials said Monday.

Economists said the leap in the number of jobless from 5.3 in December would prompt the Swiss National Bank to continue its generous monetary policy, but few expected it to cut the discount rate, already at a historic low of 1.0 percent.

The Federal Office of Trade, Industry and Labour said the jobless rolls grew by 13,330 to stand at 205,501 at the end of January, fulfilling its forecast last month that the unemployment mark would soon surpass 200,000.
